_about: An entry excuses a line when every field it gives matches: test (the leaking file's path ends with it),
state (the key or a key below it; 'global X' for a global), file and code (a frame of a queued timer in that
file whose source line holds code). Each needs a reason and state or file. An entry nothing matches in a
full run (every file, every order) fails that run. 'fix job owed' marks a real leak waiting for its fix.

allow.reason: A slice of a stopped job returns at once (slice: job ~= j), and World.finish stops the job after every test.
The farm job's next slice; a live job also shows as CP.Farm.Warming(), and a stale slice returns at once (job ~= j).

allow.code: if gen == S.gen then askNext(sender) end
allow.reason: A peer request's timeout, ASK_WAIT + 1 = 301 s later and guarded by the peer generation; no test advances that far.
The next yell, 60 s to 30 min later and guarded by the peer generation.
The login hello, 15 s later and guarded by the peer generation.
The zone-arrival digest ask, 10 s later and guarded by the generation and the arrival token.
A scan step guarded by the scan token and state; it returns at once once the scan ends.
A fade still running; it sets one region's alpha and stops at its end value.
A row's pulse runs for as long as the row pulses, by design; it only fades alpha.
The owned-row pulse driver runs while owned rows exist, by design; it only fades alpha.
HereBeDragons' own position update timer, a library loop.
fix job owed: a vendor rescan 1 s after a bag or merchant event runs in whichever test next advances the clock.
